## Summary

Describe what this pull request analyzes, reconstructs, documents, or verifies.

## Evidence / Provenance

List the evidence, public references, symbols, addresses, format observations, comparison results, or prior analysis used to support the change.

## Changes

## Verification

Explain how the result was checked. Include tests, build results, comparisons, hashes, or documented manual verification where applicable.

## Uncertainty / Follow-up

State anything that remains probable, hypothetical, unresolved, or intentionally deferred.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and placed in the correct repository area.
- [ ] Confirmed findings are distinguishable from hypotheses.
- [ ] Relevant provenance or reasoning is documented.
- [ ] New scripts or tools avoid machine-specific paths and unsafe defaults.
- [ ] Verification has been performed or the reason it cannot yet be performed is documented.
- [ ] No original, modified, or rebuilt ROM image or installable game package is included.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when this is a notable repository-level change.
